I wrote `component.html` in the folder. It's the full Requests screen at 1280px inside `#component`, with static HTML and CSS only. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked visually.

It uses your exact content and follows DESIGN.md (the v4 Screens section) and `tokens.css`. The token values I needed are copied into the file so it stands alone.

- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't available as assets here, so the file uses the token font stacks, which fall back to the system font. The heading and labels will look different from the real typefaces until those fonts load.
- **Choices I made:**
  - "All" is the selected filter, drawn as a Secondary button with an ink border.
  - "Open" and "Closed" are Quiet buttons.
  - "New Request" is the one Primary button.
  - Every status, including Approved, Closed and In review, uses the same blue pill, since DESIGN.md says no red and defines only one pill style.
  - The search field has a magnifier icon and no placeholder text, to keep to "exactly this content".

I read `session.json` and `session.err` as well. `session.json` is empty, and `session.err` only warns that the model name isn't recognized, so neither affected the design.
